Question: ____既在糖酵解又在葡萄糖异生作用中起作用。 Which enzyme acts in both glycolysis and gluconeogenesis.
Options:
A. 丙酮酸激酶 pyruvate kinase
B. 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶 glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase
C. 1，6-二磷酸果糖激酶 phosphofructokinase-1
D. 己糖激酶 hexokinase

Glycolysis vs gluconeogenesis: three irreversible steps in glycolysis bypassed in gluconeogenesis: hexokinase/glucokinase (gluconeog: glucose-6-phosphatase), PFK-1 (fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase), pyruvate kinase (pyruvate carboxylase + PEPCK). Enzymes common to both are reversible steps: e.g. aldolase, phosphoglycerate kinase, enolase, GAPDH etc. 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase? Chinese "3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶" = glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) reversible, used in both. So B.

3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶催化的反应是可逆的，既参与糖酵解，也参与葡萄糖异生作用；而丙酮酸激酶、1,6-二磷酸果糖激酶、己糖激酶所催化的步骤在糖酵解中是不可逆的，葡萄糖异生中需由其他旁路酶替代。

答案：B
